remarks: LIKE NEW & READY TO BE YOURS! Welcome to this exceptional just two-year-young, 3 bedrooms/2.5 bathrooms colonial offering the perfect blend of modern style, comfort & functionality...Located in the award-winning Orchard Park school district. The inviting front entry is spotlighted by stylish luxury plank flooring, which extends seamlessly throughout the first level...also opening up to a versatile space, ideal as a formal living room, dining room, home office, or playroom. Designed with today's lifestyle in mind, the open concept kitchen & family room create the ideal scenario for entertaining & every day living. The bright, modern kitchen showcases quartz countertops, a massive center island with abundant prep & seating space, ample white cabinetry, & stainless steel appliances, all of which are included. The family room features a cozy gas fireplace, creating the perfect gathering spot. Upstairs, you will find 2 full bathrooms, & 3 generously sized bedrooms, including a primary suite with a walk-in closet. The expansive basement offers endless potential, ready to be finished to suit your needs as a recreation room, home gym, or any additional space you desire. This fantastic home provides the peace of mind that comes with newer construction, do not miss your opportunity to own this move-in-ready home!
